source.title: Great Horned Owl Duet at Canaveral Seashore
source.author: felix.blume
source.notes: 96 kHz 24-bit stereo (Sound Devices MixPre-6), Florida, 4.5 min: a pair of great horned owls hooting back and forth, about 80 hoots at 266-330 Hz (the lower one probably the male), over the seashore's surf, which swells and falls over seconds. Filtered to 180-1500 Hz (the hoots and their second harmonic), the calls stood about 37 dB over the surf; the denoise, its profile at the 70th percentile so the swells count, takes the surf down about 10 dB more and leaves the hoots whole (floors of -30 and -18 dB took 18 and 13 dB, but what was left of the surf warbled). Whole hoot sequences, the far owl's soft replies left out.
